title: Appointments
subtitle: Site visits, meetings and calls on one calendar.

index.title: Calendar
index.body: Day, week, month and list views with clash warnings and quick outcomes.

detail.title: Appointment
detail.body: Details, directions, visit outcome and follow-up.

kpi.needOutcomeHint: Log what happened while it is fresh
kpi.toConfirmHint: In the next 36 hours, not yet confirmed

pending.title_one: {{count}} appointment is waiting for its outcome
pending.title_other: {{count}} appointments are waiting for their outcome
pending.body: The time has passed. Log the outcome so the follow-up and the stage update themselves.

empty.title: No appointments yet
empty.body: Book a site visit, an office meeting or a call. Paste a WhatsApp message and the AI fills the form.
empty.range: Nothing booked in these two weeks
empty.rangeBody: Pick another week, or book something now.
empty.dayHint: Nothing booked on this day. Click a time slot to book.

event.clash: Clashes with another booking of the same executive

conflict.title: Double booking
conflict.hint: You can still book it. Check with the executive or pick a free slot.

slots.title: Free slots for this executive
slots.none: No free slot in working hours. Try another day.

form.editBody: Change the details. A new time marks it as rescheduled.
form.isClient: This lead is already a client.
form.mapPreview: Check the location on Google Maps

actions.noShowBody: The client did not come. A task to reschedule is added for tomorrow at 11:00.
actions.deleteBody: It disappears from the calendar. Use Cancel instead if you want to keep the history.

reschedule.title: Reschedule
reschedule.body: Pick a new time. The old time is kept on record.

cancel.title: Cancel this appointment?
cancel.body: Say why, so the team knows. You can undo this for a few seconds.
cancel.taskNote: A task to reschedule was added for tomorrow at 11:00.

outcome.title: Log the outcome
outcome.describe: Describe the visit (AI fills the form)
outcome.describeHint: Type or speak what happened in your own words.
outcome.describePlaceholder: They loved Aranya Greens, his wife came too. Worried about the maintenance charge. Will decide by Sunday.
outcome.objectionsPlaceholder: Price, kitchen size, distance to school…
outcome.stageNotAllowed: You cannot move this lead's stage.
outcome.bookHint: To mark it Booked, record the token on the lead.
outcome.followUpHint: Left empty, the call after the visit is due in 24 hours.

ai.prepBody: What to check before you go, from the lead, the properties and earlier visits.
ai.prepNone: Nothing special to prepare. Confirm with the client an hour or two before.

prep.confirm: Not confirmed yet. Send the WhatsApp confirmation with the location today.
prep.noLead: No client is linked. Link a lead so the visit counts in the pipeline.
prep.unavailable: {{property}} is no longer available. Prepare alternatives before the visit.
prep.overBudget: {{property}} is {{pct}}% above the budget of {{budget}}. Carry a cost sheet and a payment plan.
prep.possession: They want ready-to-move but {{property}} is under construction. Explain the possession timeline.
prep.vastu: {{property}} is Vastu compliant. Mention it, they asked for it.
prep.facing: {{facing}} facing matches what they asked for.
prep.decisionMakers: {{name}} decides with the {{who}}. Ask them to come along, or offer a video call during the visit.
prep.loan: Needs a home loan. Carry the bank approval list ({{banks}}) and an EMI estimate.
prep.loanReady: Loan is pre-approved. Ask for the sanction letter amount.
prep.revisit_one: This is a repeat visit (they have seen {{count}} before). Focus on what changed.
prep.revisit_other: This is a repeat visit (they have seen {{count}} before). Focus on what changed.
prep.objections: Last time they said: “{{text}}”. Have an answer ready.
prep.pastNoShow: Missed a visit before. Call an hour before to confirm.
prep.urgent: {{name}} wants to buy immediately. Carry the booking form and token details.
prep.longSilence: No contact for {{days}} days. Re-confirm the requirement first.
prep.nri: NRI buyer. Offer a video walk-through for family abroad.
prep.generic: Reach 15 minutes early and check the unit, lift and parking before the client arrives.

after.readyToBook: Ready to book: call back within two hours with the booking form and the token amount.
after.interestedHigh: Strong interest with a clear favourite. Send the cost sheet tomorrow and move to negotiation.
after.interestedNoDm: Interested, but the decision maker was not there. Plan a revisit with the family.
after.interested: Interested. Share similar options and follow up in two days.
after.thinking: Thinking it over. Answer the objections and follow up in three days.
after.thinkingNoDm: Thinking it over and the decision maker was absent. Offer a revisit with the family.
after.notInterested: Not interested in these. Send different options and check in next week.

next.bookingForm: Share the booking form and token details
next.costSheet: Send the cost sheet and payment plan
next.revisitFamily: Book a revisit with the decision maker
next.alternatives: Send different options that fit better

headline.thinking: {{name}} is thinking it over after the {{type}}.

summary.dmAbsent: The decision maker was not there.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp confirmation
whatsapp.body: Ready to send to {{name}}, with the location link.
whatsapp.noPhone: This lead has no mobile number.
whatsapp.note: WhatsApp opens with the message ready. Sending is logged on the lead.

detail.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.
detail.noAccessBody: You can see appointments you own. Ask your manager if you need this one.
detail.outcomeDueBody: Use “Log outcome” above. The AI then suggests the follow-up and the stage.
detail.closedBody: A task to reschedule was added. Use Rebook to set a new time.
detail.noFollowUps: No open follow-ups for this client.
